EmailTemplate.subject: Compensation Services Request | {!Case.CaseNumber}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.Name},
We will be happy to assist you with your request. Please allow at least 2-3 business days to complete your survey request. If your request requires additional time to complete due to its size or if additional information is needed, one of our Specialists will reach out.
For compensation-related projects, one of our Consultants will be in touch and will communicate anticipated turnaround time.
If you have an urgent request or if you have any questions, please feel free to reach out to us.
We look forward to working with you.
Compensation Services
